description.value:
Starting at 2nd level, each time you gain a wizard level you may swap one wizard spell you would add to your spellbook for a Life Domain spell, provided it's of a level for which you have spell slots.

Once every Life Domain spell is in your spellbook, you may instead add any spell from the cleric list (still of a castable level). Cleric spells gained this way count as wizard spells for you, but other wizards cannot copy them from your book.
